name: question-opener
title: Question Opener
description: A curiosity-led opening card built around one strong question and compact context.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Write one direct question, keep context to one sentence, and use a short eyebrow and chapter marker.

variables.label: Question
variables.default: What changes when every idea becomes visible?

variables.label: Context
variables.default: A practical look at turning intent into shared momentum.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

useWhen: Open with one answerable question and enough context to explain why it matters.
avoidWhen: Do not use multiple unrelated questions, misleading suspense or a conclusion disguised as a question.

inputRules.eyebrow: Supply real eyebrow within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.question: Supply real question within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.context: Supply real context within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.chapter: Supply real chapter within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

readingOrder: Hold the question before the answer

cueBindings.question: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal one answerable question. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.context: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal why the question matters. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

values.question: 晚上，居民还能去哪里坐一会儿？
values.context: 从附近公共空间的开放时间说起。

example.narration: 晚上，居民还能去哪里坐一会儿？我们先看附近公共空间的开放时间。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the topic → Read one question → Read its context → Hold the question before the answer. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
usage.intent: 用一个可回答的问题和必要背景开场，让观众知道后续内容要解决什么。
